course.title: Energy Storage Systems
course.department: Department of Energy Science and Engineering

content.value: <sub>7(c).</sub> New Tesla cyber truck comes with a better battery management system (BMS). Describe BMS architecture and key features.

<sub>7(d).</sub> If Tesla have vast amount of data about various parameters of their battery pack and they want to implement a new battery model that is more accurate than previous model (as Li-ion battery system is highly non-linear and conventional models are not fully accurate), then which type of battery modelling method should they use and why?
